text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The second leg of the Classic Triple 
Crown, the Japanese Derby. To prevent him 
from being late, the Trainer asked Dorm 
Head Hishi Amazon to drag Seiun Sky out of 
bed.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Tokyo Racecourse is buzzing with 
excitement over the clash of the Big 
Three. The overwhelming favorite is 
Special Week, who has made winning the 
Derby her lifelong dream.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, winning the Derby is naturally 
not Special Week's dream alone. The clash 
between the Big Three begins once more—!
